bootstrap.method: Whole games with replacement within old/new holdout; fixed stratum sizes; identical paired draws for all four endpoints; ratios of summed counts.
bootstrap.interval: Pointwise two-sided 95% percentile; no simultaneous or random-seed population coverage.

limitations: Four complete vectors; no per-action/seed/checkpoint assembly.
The added absolute precision gates do not compare old v1/parent/nllReference.
Choice-only complete candidate equality is the target; type and conditional accuracy are diagnostics.
Kita structurally N/A; insufficient support for applicable actions cannot pass.
Both seeds must pass original full screen plus treatment absolute precision.
No chi FPR cap inferred from daiminkan; all true negative opportunities retained.
